body:
```suggestion
			When enabled, text that is too large to fit the button is clipped horizontally. When disabled, the button will always be wide enough to hold the text. The text is not vertically clipped, and the button's height is not affected by this property.
```
Or more concise:
```suggestion
			When enabled, text that is too large to fit the button is clipped horizontally. When disabled, the button will always be wide enough to hold the text. The text is not vertically clipped, and height is not affected.
```

Or use "If `true`" style, which is recommended generally but this class doesn't currently use (are there exceptions for properties which are usually set in the inspector?):
```suggestion
			If [code]true[/code], text that is too large to fit the button is clipped horizontally. If [code]false[/code], the button will always be wide enough to hold the text. The text is not vertically clipped, and height is not affected.
```
